newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Alusuisse sees 1996 sales of eight bln Sfr.
newsitem.headline: Alusuisse sees 1996 sales of eight bln Sfr.

text.p: Kurt Wolfensberger, member of the executive board of Alusuisse-Lonza Holding AG, said the group expects sales this year to rise to about eight billion Swiss francs from 1995's 7.49 billion.
"All in all the Alusuisse-Lonza Group, which employs 31,000 people worldwide, expects turnover this year of about eight billion Swiss francs," Wolfensberger told a news conference.
Sales at Alusuisse's aluminium activities will account for about one-third of these sales, he added.
This includes sales of 200 million in the division for mass transportation and 300 million from displays and facades.
Total sales from the industry market organisation should be around 850 million francs, he added.
Wolfensberger also repeated that Alusuisse expects higher net profit for 1996 compared with 1995's 385 million francs.
